user.title: ClimateSync – Step 1: Source Rooms
user.description: Select one or more climate entities (rooms) whose heating demand ClimateSync will track. Each room must expose a current temperature and a target temperature.

select_mode.title: ClimateSync – Step 2: Operating Mode
select_mode.description:
Choose how ClimateSync controls the destination thermostat.

**Delta Mode (Default)** — Works with any thermostat. ClimateSync finds the room with the highest heat demand (largest gap between target and current temperature) and adds that gap on top of the destination's own temperature. Simple and universally compatible.

**Offset Mode (Advanced)** — Makes the destination thermostat behave exactly like the room with the highest heat demand. Instead of adjusting the setpoint directly, ClimateSync shifts the thermostat's temperature offset so that it 'sees' the leading room's temperature and reacts accordingly. Requires the destination thermostat to expose a temperature offset entity (number or input_number).

destination.title: ClimateSync – Step 3: Destination & Settings
destination.description:
Select the thermostat that ClimateSync will control. The **idle temperature** is used when no room needs heating. The **maximum setpoint** caps how high ClimateSync will ever set the destination (prevents runaway spikes). The **rounding mode** determines how the setpoint is rounded before being sent.

If you selected **Offset Mode**, also provide the offset entity that your thermostat exposes.

data.idle_temperature: Idle temperature (°C) – used when no room needs heating
data.max_setpoint: Maximum setpoint (°C) – hard ceiling for the destination setpoint
data.offset_entity: Offset entity (number or input_number exposed by the thermostat)

error.no_sources: Please select at least one source climate entity.
error.dest_is_source: The destination thermostat cannot also be a source room.
error.no_offset_entity: Please select an offset entity. Offset Mode requires a temperature offset entity (number or input_number) exposed by the thermostat.

init.title: ClimateSync – Step 1: Source Rooms
init.description: Change which climate entities (rooms) ClimateSync tracks for heating demand.

select_mode.title: ClimateSync – Step 2: Operating Mode
select_mode.description:
Choose how ClimateSync controls the destination thermostat.

**Delta Mode (Default)** — Works with any thermostat. ClimateSync finds the room with the highest heat demand and adds that gap on top of the destination's own temperature.

**Offset Mode (Advanced)** — Makes the destination thermostat behave exactly like the room with the highest heat demand by adjusting the thermostat's temperature offset. Requires the thermostat to expose an offset entity.

destination.title: ClimateSync – Step 3: Destination & Settings
destination.description:
Change the destination thermostat and adjust all settings. **Maximum setpoint**: hard ceiling to prevent runaway spikes. **Resync interval**: how often ClimateSync checks even without changes. **Min change threshold**: smallest setpoint change worth sending. **Min send interval**: minimum seconds between two service calls (rate limiter).

If you selected **Offset Mode**, also provide the offset entity.
